text:
Sam: heads up — link-checker just reported a 404 on an anchor in /handbook/runtime.md (#kv-cache). I bumped into it while following the onboarding guide.

docs-bot: link-checker alert: 404 found at /handbook/runtime.md#kv-cache (scan id: lc-2026-0321-17). Recommend quick fix or redirect.

Lia: I own the runtime handbook area, I can take this.

Sam: thanks Lia. it's a small anchor rename — looks like the section id changed after the refactor. quick fix should be a PR to update the inbound links and keep the old shortlink if possible.

Jordan: fwiw that anchor is referenced from onboarding/quickstart.md and from the internal runbook. Can we prefer changing the inbound links to the new anchor instead of re-adding the old one?

Lia: yeah i'll open a tiny PR that updates the two inbound links. patch will be something like:
```
# in docs repo
git checkout -b docs/fix/kv-cache
rg "runtime.md#kv-cache" -n || true
# replace with new anchor
sed -i 's/runtime.md#kv-cache/runtime.md#kv-cache-v2/g' onboarding/quickstart.md handbook/runbooks/internal.md
git add -u && git commit -m "docs: update kv-cache anchors to kv-cache-v2"
```

Maria: please tag me on the PR @Maria, i'll do a quick review. also add a note in docs/CHANGELOG.md so audits know it was intentional.

Devon: heads-up — our incident runbook references that anchor in the /runbook snippet. i'll watch the PR and send a follow-up patch if anything else breaks.

Sam: :thumbsup: appreciate the fast turnaround. Lia, when you open the PR can you include the scan id in the description so ops can cross-reference? quick pinging @Maria and @Devon for review after you open it.

Lia: will do. ETA ~25m for the PR.

Maria: noted, will prioritize review when it's up.

docs-bot: link-checker: automated re-scan scheduled in 1h. set a reminder if you want immediate verification.

Sam: perfect — thanks everyone. small async win :)
